cs_audience.definition: The people who are present and watching when you act.
cs_audience.example: With the customer in the room, the audience changed what he said.

delegation.definition: Assigning a task and the authority to complete it; with agents, the responsibility still stays with the delegator.

gre_household_labour.definition: The work of running the house: cleaning, shopping, cooking, laundry and bills.
gre_household_labour.example: Household labour is the part of the week that never appears on a report.

reference.definition: A person your former employer allows a new employer to contact to check your work history.
reference.example: Could you give me a reference from your last manager?

star.definition: A ball of hot gas that makes its own light. The Sun is a star.
star.example: That bright dot is a star, shining all by itself.
